purpose: Define the canonical rule that incompatible semantic change creates a new identity rather than silently mutating the meaning of an existing identity.

owns: Breaking Change Requires New Identity semantics

value.breaking_rule: Semantic incompatibility that cannot preserve prior meaning requires an explicit new canonical identity.
value.migration_rule: Old→new migration/mapping may be declared separately.
value.alias_rule: Legacy alias may point to new identity only with explicit compatibility/migration semantics.
value.version_rule: Merely incrementing a version is insufficient when identity meaning breaks.
value.authority_rule: New identity does not inherit old runtime/AccessCore rights automatically.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.

references.purpose: Breaking changes leave stable prior identities intact.
